title: Mobility Equipment Retail Schedule — Adjustment Percentage by Warranty Repair Jobs on a Kept Chair
content:
# Adjustment Percentage on a Kept Cash-Sale Chair — Mobility Equipment

**Schedule rule.** On a Mobility Equipment chair sold for cash that the patient keeps, the adjustment percentage of the price adjustment depends on the repair jobs posted on the chair under the manufacturer's warranty: 20 percent with 3 or more such jobs, 15 percent with exactly 2, and the standard adjustment percentage with fewer. The adjustment percentage acts on the price on the sale line alone, and no restocking percentage is withheld, because the chair does not come back.

## Jobs counted

Every repair job in the chair's service history whose cost is borne by the manufacturer's warranty, whatever the component repaired. Repairs paid by the patient or billed to a payer are not counted.

## Schedule

| Warranty repair jobs posted on the chair | Adjustment percentage of the price |
|---|---|
| 0 or 1 | the standard adjustment percentage |
| exactly 2 | 15 percent |
| 3 or more | 20 percent |

## Hypothetical illustrations (sale line price 3995.00)

- 2 warranty jobs: 15 percent of 3995.00 is 599.25.
- 3 warranty jobs: 20 percent of 3995.00 is 799.00.
